proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization and Target registration support the inferred Spawned role. The separate Klaptrap registration contains Logic10 symbols; it does not establish that numeric identity for Mato. Removing the unsupported qualifier improves the rendered name without claiming recovery of an original symbol.

The complete wrapper ignores its argument, calls Ground_801C4338 once and returns true. The complete ground callee decrements x6D4 unconditionally and ORs flag 0x20 only on an exact-zero result. Neither body contains duplicate-notification protection or a positive-count guard. This useful cross-file detail agrees with functionality.md.
